## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all pass
- [ ] No em dash or en dash in any changed file
- [ ] README.md and README.id.md updated and in sync (same sections, same order)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.id.md updated under Unreleased
- [ ] No secrets, models, or local-only files committed
- [ ] If user-facing behavior changed, docs/PRD.md deviations section updated
